items.q: How can I book a car?
items.a: Through the form on the website, WhatsApp or by phone. We are available 24/7.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my booking?
items.a: Yes, free of charge up to 24 hours before pickup. Call us or send a WhatsApp message.

items.q: What do I need to rent a car?
items.a: A valid driving licence, an ID card or passport and a credit or debit card for the deposit.

items.q: What is included in the price?
items.a: Insurance, unlimited mileage, free delivery within Sarajevo Canton and 24/7 roadside assistance.
200 € for every car, except the Audi Q7 and Mercedes E-Class where it is 300 €. It is refunded in full once the car is returned in order.

items.q: What if I have an accident?
items.a: Call the police and us immediately. Don't move the car until the police arrive, and we'll guide you through the next steps.
